children: on Wednesday it increased the size of its non-brokered private placement up to C$3M from C$2M.
The company will offer up to 13.04M units at C$0.23 per unit, with each unit comprising one common share and one-half a warrant.
Each whole warrant allows the holder to purchase an additional share for C$0.375 for 24 months following the offering's closing.
The proceeds will be used for exploration and drilling in Argentina and Peru, including its Cerro Bayo, La Flora, and Antonella projects, as well as general working capital.

title: Daura Gold upsizes non-brokered private placement to C$3M
